TanitAD · Data FlyWheel · P2 label pipeline

Label extraction, rebuilt overnight

The whole 26.2-hour Alpamayo corpus now labels end to end in 30 seconds with zero refusals. Goal/action contradictions fell from 21.7 % to 0.40 %, and a control found one token firing 408× more often on empty scenes than on occupied ones. Twelve scenes below were drawn at random and checked against their own frames — which is how every defect here was found, and how the data caught two wrong calls of my own.

What you asked me to confirm — and where I was wrong

You were right and I was wrong on both counts. The augmentation is 4,729 clips = 26.3 hours, pushed to Sayood/tanitad-alpamayo2-augmentation, and it carries five tasks, not one. meta_action is present on every clip. My claim that it was "not reachable locally" and that the data was "limited" described a 801-clip subset I had imposed myself, read from a four-field export I had mistaken for the dataset.

TaskCoverageWhat it givesUsed before
meta_action4,729 · 100 % 3-axis action + CoT. The best lateral corroborator — 69.9 % vs 41.6 % chance. no
auto_labeling4,729 · 100 % Typed, time-stamped motion segments (97.1 % parse) + the forcing object. type: none on 853 clips is an explicit clean negative. no
grounding_via_vqa4,411 · 93.3 % 2D boxes, and they are accurate — verified pixel-level on two clips. no
vqa4,722 · 99.9 % 21 semantic categories — but a sampled bank, ~0.3 % coverage per question. Spot-checks only.no
trajectory4,729 · 100 % Alpamayo's own predicted path and its ADE/FDE.no
cot4,729 · 100 % The single field the pipeline had been using. yes
The anchor was misaligned all along. Alpamayo's t0_us is 5.1 s; our label anchor is 8.0 s. Every cross-source number published before today compared moments 2.9 s apart — about 29 m at urban speed. Scoring each source on its own window moved longitudinal agreement from 54.9 % to 62.1 % with no change to the data.

Five defects found by looking at frames

Each was found by checking a random scene against its own pixels, not by a test. All five are fixed and pinned; the measured effect of each is below.

DefectHow it showed upBeforeAfter
Substring collision
"_L" in "FOLLOW_LANE"		 Every straight clip scored as a LEFT turn, so Alpamayo's lateral axis read worse than chance one hour after it measured 69.9 %. 24.9 %64.2 %
A turn in neither layer A −94° turn running 4.5→14.8 s was skipped by the strategic filter (starts <6 s) and by the tactical one (only reads the first manoeuvre). A straddling manoeuvre now populates both. droppedboth layers
EVADE without lateral motion 74 % of EVADE emissions had no nudge at all — a sentence about an evasion, not an evasion. Geometry must now show the movement; the CoT names the object. 932238
Two detectors, one fact Goal read manoeuvre_sequence, action read EM.analyse; 219 clips carried a TURN goal beside lat=LANE_KEEP. 2190
Stop-then-launch An ego already at rest that departs was labelled STOP_POINT beside lon=ACCELERATE: the plan's content is the departure. 1016
Negated terms read as present
the 408x inversion		 "…with no lead vehicle pedestrians cyclists traffic lights or obstacles" emitted TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT. Found by a CONTROL, not a test: splitting the corpus by Alpamayo's own "nothing is critical" and checking the rates ran the right way. Two tokens ran backwards. 53318
A stopped bus is not an overtake "Nudge left to pass the stopped bus" matched no obstacle class, so the clip was labelled FOLLOW_LANE alone. A stopped object is STATIC — EVADE. missedEVADE
What caught the biggest defect was a control, not a test. Nothing was failing. The tokens looked plausible one clip at a time. Splitting the corpus by an independent source's own negative — 853 clips where Alpamayo states nothing is critical — and requiring the rates to run in a known direction is what exposed it. GAP_TARGET at 0.04x and YIELD at 0.21x ran correctly; TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT at 408x did not.

⚠️ And I had already probed negation that night, measured "3.5 % of clips — small", and moved on. That probe searched for no within 40 characters of a term; it could not express a six-term enumeration under a single no, which is the shape that actually occurs. An instrument that cannot detect X in the form X takes will report that X is rare.
Two of tonight's errors were mine, in the fix itself. I built a contradicted state on the boxes — "the clip has boxes, none of kind X, therefore X is absent". Invalid: there is exactly one grounding question per clip, and 3,246 clips with boxes were never asked about pedestrians at all. Grounding can confirm, never refute. And my first coherence check tested only "TURN goal but no turn action", never the converse — so a fix I made broke 70 clips the other way and the check certified them. Both directions are tested now.

Three corrections from your review of 43bbcbf9

One screenshot, three real defects — and the third of them hid a fourth in my own fix.

What you flaggedWhat was wrongBeforeAfter
Strategic extracted at 6 s The emitter used 0–6 s for tactical and called everything from 6 s on strategic. Both ends wrong: 0–2 s belongs to the operative layer, and the strategic band opens at 8 s. Symptom: a route-level token stamped by_time_s: 6.0. 4350
Tactical should be 2–6 s Now OPERATIVE (0,2) · TACTICAL (2,6) · STRATEGIC (8,30), which exposes a real gap: nothing owns 6–8 s. Manoeuvres landing only there are reported as unassigned rather than absorbed — 54 clips (1.1 %), a design question for you rather than an emitter default. 0–6 s2–6 s
Long curves read as turns Two causes. The radius came from peak instantaneous curvature, so one noisy sample set it — 40 m where the arc says 144 m. And there was no speed condition at all. Now |Δyaw| ≥ 15° AND R_arc ≤ 140 m AND v_min ≤ 8 m/s, swept against Alpamayo's own turn labels (349 turns vs 1,468 keep-lane). 987615
Your mechanism was right; the signal was not. You predicted turns are found by strong deceleration into the curve. In the 2–6 s band a turning ego is accelerating — median +2.2 m/s — because it is already exiting, so dv separates nothing. Turn clips are already slow four seconds before the anchor (5.4 vs 14.0 m/s): the braking happens outside every window we observe. The gate therefore uses absolute speed, and it earns its place — removing 70 of 159 false positives (44 %) and lifting precision 58.4 % → 70.6 %.

⚠️ Fixing the goal side alone re-created the two-detector defect in mirror image: 329 clips gained lat=TURN with no turn goal. Coherence went 0.40 % → 7.16 % → 0.21 % once both sides read the same gated list.

Your MERGE question, and the three defects behind it

You asked why 59b57590 emitted MERGE when its CoT never mentions one. It doesn't — and answering that found larger problems sitting beside it.

DefectWhat it wasBeforeAfter
MERGE from a hazard phrase The only "merg" in the text is "potential door-opening/merge hazards" — a hypothetical risk class in a compound noun. Negation scoping cannot catch this: "potential" is irrealis, not negation. 12982
The lane change was never read The clip opens with "Change lanes to the left" — the manoeuvre it is about — and produced nothing. LANE_CHANGE_L/R were frozen, defined, and in the matrix with no extraction path at all. 174 clips state a lane change; zero got a token. 039
Only the first component was read components_analysis is a numbered list on 197 clips. Here we kept "Lane divider" and discarded the parked vehicles, the traffic lights and the lead vehicle. 3,1073,733
25 % of the vocabulary was dead 13 of 52 frozen tokens were never emitted on the entire corpus. The strategic layer was worst: only 3 of 8 goals and 2 of 7 actions reachable, because it handled turns and nothing else. 39/5243/52
Freezing a token is not the same as being able to emit one. LANE_CHANGE_L passed the freeze test, had a definition in the matrix, and could never be produced. Every check we had passed. There is now a reachability test: each frozen token either has an extraction path or is listed in NOT_YET_EXTRACTABLE with a reason. Nine remain, each naming what it would take — a head sized to this vocabulary would otherwise train nine permanently empty classes.

Newly reachable from geometry alone: STOP_AT_FOLLOW_ROUTE (469), PREPARE_STOP_FOLLOW_ROUTE (469), RESUME_CRUISE_FOLLOW_ROUTE (573), CREEP (63).
Why only 39 of 176 lane changes survive. A lane change must show lateral motion. Measuring cross-track residual with the road's own arc removed, against a matched control: +0.07 m (2–6 s), +0.41 m (Alpamayo's window), +1.02 m (−3…+8 s). The signal is real and grows with the window, but the median claimed lane change never displaces a full lane width (~3.5 m) in anything we observe. The 39 admitted are the ones geometry can confirm; loosening the gate would manufacture labels. ⚠️ My first version of this measured deviation from the initial heading and put the control at 7.95 m — any curve produces that. A displacement measure without the arc removed is measuring the road.

Four corrections from your second review

What you flaggedWhat it wasBeforeAfter
Is MERGE fixed? Yes. The hazard-phrase guard holds — 0 MERGE tokens now come from a "potential …/merge hazards" construction. 12982
SPEED_BAND should always be there It was gated on the speed being held, which deleted the target speed from exactly the scenes where it matters. A target speed interval is a property every plan has; whether it is held is the action's verdict. Now unconditional — and the (SPEED_BAND, STOP_POINT) exclusion was retired, since a stop is a band of 0.0–0.0, which is information, not a contradiction. 1,4404,719
Description still said 0–6 s ⛔ Not just a label. tactical_goals() was still computing SPEED_BAND, STOP_POINT and the anchor from 0 s — over ground the OPERATIVE layer owns. Only the turn split had been moved to 2–6 s. The header was accurately describing the code. The anchor now carries band_s so the window can never again be implicit. 0–6 s2–6 s
Goal vs action not distinguished Every token now carries an explicit ROLE_OF — goal (what to achieve, and by when), action (what to do now about it), input (nav). The tables below label each row. implicit26 / 23 / 3
The target speed band now discriminates the situation, which is what makes it worth having on every clip — measured medians: stopping 0.00–1.40, turning 4.52–7.11, cruising 12.78–13.16 m/s.
A correction to what I told you last time. I said this clip "now emits LANE_CHANGE_L". It does not, and should not — I had checked the CoT extractor's output and reported it as the emitter's. The emitter applies a lateral-evidence gate, and this ego displaces 0.01–0.05 m with the road's arc removed. It never changes lane in view. The extractor finds the phrase; the gate correctly refuses the token.

Is the oncoming label in the right time slot?

No — and it cannot be, on present evidence. You spotted it in the past frames, and the data agrees.

QuestionMeasurementResult
Do CoT tokens carry a time? A CoT claim has no timestamp. Only Alpamayo's parsed motion segments give one, and 1,845 clips (39.0 %) have no time information whatsoever — no segments, no "first N seconds" phrase. d94365be is one of them. 87.2 % untimed
Specifically REACT_ON_ONCOMING Not a single emission is supported by a timed segment. 0 timed / 344
Why it lands in the past Alpamayo's anchor is 5.1 s, ours is 8.0 s. Its text describes a window starting 2.9 s before ours, so an event it names can finish before our tactical band opens. −2.9 s
And the two texts disagree On d94365be: cot "nudge LEFT due to the parked car", chain_of_causation "nudge RIGHT due to the oncoming vehicle". My concatenation was feeding the extractor both halves of a contradiction. 49 clips
What changed rather than what I concluded. Every CoT-derived goal now carries time_basis: timed when a parsed motion segment overlapping 2–6 s mentions it, untimed when the band placement is an assumption nothing supports. A consumer that weights those equally is now choosing to. On a direction conflict the primary cot field wins and the secondary is dropped (48 clips).

⚠️ I am not deleting the untimed tokens. They are 87 % of the perception signal, and the claims are often true — they are just not placed. Marking them is honest; discarding them would throw away most of what Alpamayo knows. Whether an untimed token should train the tactical head is your call, and the field is there so you can make it.

My reading of the frames: ⭐ THE PI'S RULE, APPLIED — final trial. Geometry scored a turn (−42.7° at R 12.2 m, walking speed) but the CoT says nudge left to pass the parked vehicle and no turn word appears anywhere → it is not a turn. The TURN and YIELD_FOR_TURN tokens are now SUPPRESSED: the label reads NUDGE_R + EVADE/FOLLOW_LANE + SPEED_BAND, and nav no longer commands a turn. 68 clips corpus-wide follow this rule; each carries a `turn_suppression` record with the evidence, so the set stays auditable and recoverable when the lane-detector reference lands. Known accepted cost: ec075947's real −78° corner also carries parked-car text and loses its turn tokens — the PI chose the trade knowingly.

Alpamayo source, verbatim — meta_action and all four text fields
meta_actionlongitudinal Gentle Deceleration · lateral Go Straight · lane Lane Keep
cotChange lanes left and slow due to the upcoming intersection with red signals and the rightmost lane becoming a right-turn-only lane, ensuring the ego remains in a through lane and maintains safe spacing.
chain_of_causationChange lanes to the left due to the rightmost lane becoming a right-turn-only lane ahead and a red traffic light requiring a stop behind the lead vehicle.
critical_components1. Type: Traffic light (red)
Why it is critical: A set of red signals controls the intersection ahead and requires the ego vehicle to slow and prepare to stop.

2. Type: Right-turn-only lane markings/signs
Why it is critical: The rightmost lane transitions into a dedicated right-turn lane ahead; staying there would force a right turn. Ego must reposition to continue straight.

3. Type: Lead vehicle (white car) in the adjacent through lane
Why it is critical: It is ahead in the lane ego intends to merge into and will determine the following gap as ego approaches the red light.

4. Type: Pedestrian crossing marks
Why it is critical: Crosswalks at the intersection define the stop line area and require yielding when the light is red.

5. Type: Lane boundaries (dashed lane lines)
Why it is critical: They define the lane change path and the moment ego crosses into the adjacent lane.
motion_analysis—
My reading of the frames: Night junction, red heads visible from the anchor on. STOP_POINT@15.3 m + TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT_RED + BRAKE_TO, band 0.0–4.81 m/s. The CoT also claims a lane change left; the lateral-evidence gate refuses it (measured LANE_KEEP) — in the dark frames no lane change is visible either. An honest refusal, shown as one.

Where the labels land across the corpus

The vocabulary — frozen, with definitions

You noted the definitions had gone missing between documents. They now live in vocab_v7.py beside the token tuples, and a test asserts every frozen token has one and that no definition outlives its token — a markdown file is what allowed them to drift. The vocabulary is frozen as you instructed: the tuples are tensor dimensions, and a test pins their exact order.

Strategic GOALS · 8–30 s · WHAT comes next on the route, and when 8 tokens

FOLLOW_ROUTENo overnext manoeuvre in the lookahead: stay on the route as it runs. The default, and ~84 % of clips -- a skew a consumer must weight.
TURN_LEFT_FOLLOW_ROUTEThe manoeuvre AFTER the tactical one is a left turn, then the route continues. The _FOLLOW_ROUTE suffix is the PI's: it names what happens once the turn is done, so the token is not mistaken for the turn the plan is currently executing.
TURN_RIGHT_FOLLOW_ROUTEAs TURN_LEFT_FOLLOW_ROUTE, to the right.
STOP_AT_FOLLOW_ROUTEThe overnext event is a stop (light, sign, queue), after which the route continues.
EXIT_LEFT_FOLLOW_ROUTEThe overnext manoeuvre leaves the current road to the left (ramp/split), then follows the new road.
EXIT_RIGHT_FOLLOW_ROUTEAs EXIT_LEFT_FOLLOW_ROUTE, to the right.
LANE_CHANGE_L_FOLLOW_ROUTEThe overnext manoeuvre is a lane change to the left required by the ROUTE, not by traffic.
LANE_CHANGE_R_FOLLOW_ROUTEAs LANE_CHANGE_L_FOLLOW_ROUTE, to the right.

Strategic ACTIONS · what to DO NOW about that goal — never changes the current tactical manoeuvre 7 tokens

HOLD_MAIN_ROADNothing to prepare for: remain on the main road. Replaces the old HOLD_CORRIDOR, which read as a lateral instruction and produced the 'HOLD_CORRIDOR while turning' contradiction the PI caught.
PREPARE_TURN_L_FOLLOW_ROUTEBegin setting up for a left turn that is NOT in the current 6 s plan. Args carry within_m and by_time_s, so it is explicit that this does NOT affect the current tactical manoeuvre -- the PI's requirement.
PREPARE_TURN_R_FOLLOW_ROUTEAs PREPARE_TURN_L_FOLLOW_ROUTE, but for a right turn.
PREPARE_STOP_FOLLOW_ROUTESet up for a stop beyond the tactical horizon.
PREPARE_EXIT_FOLLOW_ROUTESet up to leave the road at the overnext opportunity.
PREPARE_LANE_CHANGE_FOLLOW_ROUTEPosition for a route-required lane change beyond the plan.
RESUME_CRUISE_FOLLOW_ROUTEThe constraint that forced a slowdown ends within the strategic band; return to road-class speed.

Tactical GOALS · 2–6 s · multi-label · what is to be achieved 22 tokens

FOLLOW_LANEStay in the current lane along the road as it runs. The fallback when no other goal applies.
TURN_LExecute a left turn WITHIN the 6 s plan. Per the PI: a turn inside the plan is TACTICAL, never strategic.
TURN_RAs TURN_L, to the right.
YIELD_FOR_TURN_LA left turn that must first give way -- the ego holds, then turns. ONE goal, not two, because the yield and the turn are a single intent.
YIELD_FOR_TURN_RAs YIELD_FOR_TURN_L, to the right.
YIELDGive way without a turn -- to a sign, a merge, or a hazard.
STOP_POINTCome to rest at a specific place; args carry within_m and hold_for_s.
SPEED_BANDThe TARGET SPEED INTERVAL over the tactical band: min and max speed between 2 s and 6 s (args v_lo_ms / v_hi_ms / band_s). ALWAYS PRESENT on every clip -- PI 2026-08-27: 'Speed should be actually always there because it describes the target speed'. It was previously gated on the speed being HELD, which deleted the target speed from exactly the scenes where it matters most; whether the speed is held is the LONGITUDINAL ACTION's verdict (CRUISE / ACCELERATE / BRAKE_TO), and the `held` arg here is descriptive only. A stop is a band of 0.0-0.0, which is information, not a contradiction. MEASURED medians: stopping 0.00-1.40, turning 4.52-7.11, cruising 12.78-13.16 m/s.
CORRIDOR_OFFSETHold a lateral offset inside the lane without leaving it.
EVADE_IN_CORRIDORPI's definition: a lateral adjustment for a STATIC obstacle or a VRU -- parked car, open door, cyclist, pedestrian. Stays in the corridor; does NOT change lane. The object does not move; that is what separates it from OVERTAKE_VEHICLE.
OVERTAKE_VEHICLEPI's definition: pass a SLOWER MOVING vehicle ahead. The object moves. Extraction order matters -- 'pass the parked car' is EVADE, 'pass the slow truck' is OVERTAKE, and mis-ordering files 419 parked-car evasions as overtakes.
MERGEJoin a stream of traffic from a ramp or a closing lane.
GAP_TARGETAim for a specific gap in an adjacent stream; args name the gap.
REACT_ON_ONCOMINGRespond to oncoming traffic -- renamed from WAIT_FOR_ONCOMING at the PI's request, because the response is not always a wait.
TAKE_EXIT_LLeave the road to the left. Extracted from CoT TERMS, not geometry -- the PI's instruction, and geometry cannot tell an exit from a bend.
TAKE_EXIT_RAs TAKE_EXIT_L, to the right.
TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACTReact to a traffic light whose colour was NOT extracted.
TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT_REDReact to a light observed RED.
TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT_YELLOWReact to a light observed YELLOW or amber.
TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT_GREENReact to a light observed GREEN -- a reaction, not the absence of one: the ego proceeds BECAUSE the light permits it.
LANE_CHANGE_LMove to the lane on the left within the plan.
LANE_CHANGE_RMove to the lane on the right within the plan.

Tactical lateral ACTIONS · the control output, 2–6 s 8 tokens

LANE_KEEPHold the lane centre.
LANE_CHANGE_LMove to the lane on the left within the plan.
LANE_CHANGE_RMove to the lane on the right within the plan.
ABORT_LCAbandon a lane change already begun and return.
NUDGE_LSmall lateral displacement left, staying in lane.
NUDGE_RSmall lateral displacement right, staying in lane.
TURN_LExecute a left turn WITHIN the 6 s plan. Per the PI: a turn inside the plan is TACTICAL, never strategic.
TURN_RAs TURN_L, to the right.

Tactical longitudinal ACTIONS · the control output, 2–6 s 8 tokens

FOLLOWTrack the lead vehicle's speed, holding a gap.
CRUISEHold speed; |dv| < 1.0 m/s across the plan.
YIELD_MERGESlow to let a merging agent in.
BRAKE_TODecelerate to a target speed or a stop point.
CREEPMove slowly forward, typically to see past an occlusion.
HOLDRemain stationary at a standstill, brakes applied.
ADAPT_SPEED_FOR_CURVEPI's token, replacing ADAPT_SPEED_FOR_TURNING to make it universal: adjust speed for path curvature -- a junction turn OR a sharp bend. Set automatically when a turn manoeuvre is detected.
ACCELERATEPI's addition: a significant positive speed change, dv > +1.5 m/s across the plan.

Nav commands · model INPUT, not a target 3 tokens

NAV_FOLLOW_ROADNavigation says: continue on the current road. This is an INPUT to the model, derived here from the ego future -- an ORACLE, admissible for training only, and never a target.
NAV_TURN_LNavigation says: turn left; args carry distance and time to the turn.
NAV_TURN_RNavigation says: turn right; args as NAV_TURN_L.

What is still wrong

  • Traffic lights are still under-read on rich scenes. d452ea24 shows red lights at −4 s that no token captures — the CoT for that clip talks only about the bus, so there is nothing to extract from. This is a source-coverage limit, not an extraction bug, and it is the honest ceiling of a CoT-driven approach.
  • 19 clips (0.40 %) still carry a goal/action contradiction: 10 with lat=TURN and no turn goal, 9 pairing STOP_POINT with a non-braking longitudinal action.
  • Grounding reaches only ~13 % of CoT tokens — a ceiling set by the one sampled question per clip, not by our logic. It cannot be raised without re-running the grounding task with more questions per clip.
  • The explicit none cannot be used to suppress tokens. I proposed this as the top fix, then checked its scope: all 853 are worded "the first 2 seconds", which from Alpamayo's 5.1 s anchor is −2.9 to −0.9 s relative to ours — it does not overlap our window. It is still valuable as a CONTROL, which is exactly how it found the 408× inversion.
  • Alpamayo's trajectory task is still unused — its predicted path and ADE/FDE per clip are banked but nothing reads them yet.
